name: Nalwa Sons Investments Limited
summary: Nalwa Sons Investments Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the investment and financing business in India. The company operates through the Investment & Finance, and Trading of Goods segments. The company primarily holds investments in equity shares of steel manufacturing companies of O.P. Jindal Group. The company was formerly known as Jindal Strips Limited and changed its name to Nalwa Sons Investments Limited. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is based in New Delhi, India.
